draft-r4-a5000.label: Draft — R4 quick iteration candidate
draft-r4-a5000.description: R4 candidate for quicker iteration on A5000. Uses fewer sigma points than Balanced; target-host quality must be judged from R4 evidence and is not reference/lossless.
draft-r4-a5000.disclosure: Uses pruned INT8 ConvRot DiT and quantized Qwen3-VL text encoder with fewer sampling points; approximate/fast tradeoff, not lossless/reference quality.

balanced-r2-a5000.label: Balanced — R2/R3 A5000 proven route
balanced-r2-a5000.description: R2 accepted single A5000 ComfyUI/RH MiniMax-H3 route and R3 product route. R4 records concurrent throughput separately.
balanced-r2-a5000.disclosure: Uses pruned INT8 ConvRot DiT and quantized Qwen3-VL text encoder; not presented as lossless/reference quality.

final-r4-a5000.label: Final — R4 higher-step candidate
final-r4-a5000.description: R4 candidate for higher-quality output on A5000. Uses more sigma points than Balanced at the same MVP geometry; it is still quantized/pruned and not a lossless/reference route.
final-r4-a5000.disclosure: Uses pruned INT8 ConvRot DiT and quantized Qwen3-VL text encoder with more sampling points; higher-step quantized output, not lossless/reference quality.
